notes: Highwater ran Hosted API trial then asked for Dedicated sizing. Product is a mid-market in-app assistant + search for product analytics. Trial results and asks below. Trial was eye-opening: streaming chat worked well for small contexts but heavy tails and batch summarization stressed trial tier. They want a predictable Dedicated baseline with burst for launches. Notes capture trial metrics, ask list, and next steps.
trial_summary: Trial dates: 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-28; 95k trial tokens used then metered. Workloads: 60% streaming chat (in-app), 20% embeddings for search, 12% nightly summarization jobs (long), 8% reranking. Median request tokens 240, mean ~480 due to long-tail. Token mix observed: short ~37%, medium ~48%, long ~15%. Observed baseline QPS 7-14, daily peak 68 QPS, one engineered spike to 210 QPS (load test) caused throttling. Peak concurrency observed 22 active streams; stress test reached 140 concurrent for 90s causing 429s on trial plan.
p95_latency_target: <= 1.8s for chat at 2k context; acceptable fallback to 3s during bursts; batch summarization p95 <= 6s
customer_requests: Formal Dedicated configuration to support sustained 100 QPS with p95 <=2s at 4k context; separate embedding pool optimized for batching; 2x headroom in 12 months; clear reserved vs burst pricing; KMS customer-managed key support; SOC2 evidence for procurement.

requested_capacity: Initial ask: reserved pool sized for sustained 100-120 QPS with p95<=2s at 4k context plus burst capacity to 380 QPS. SE proposes: 3 x A100-80GB equiv for low-latency streaming chat; 2 x A10/A40 for embeddings (batch 64-256); burst nodes on demand (2-4 nodes) to absorb spikes. Include autoscaling policy for 2x growth within 6-9 months.
cost_sensitivity: High-moderate: mid-market procurement. Wants monthly predictable commit but needs transparent add-on burst pricing. Requests a per-team token dashboard for internal chargeback and a blended cost comparison hosted vs dedicated.
sizing_notes_from_se: Ethan: separate chat and embedding pools recommended. For chat at 4k context and current token mix, 3x A100-80GB equiv expected to meet p95<=2s at sustained 100 QPS with KV cache and batching. Embeddings cluster sized to maximize batching efficiency (64-128) using A10/A40. Suggest Reserve+Burst model with 20-30% headroom reserved + on-demand burst nodes.
